description: All 161 national-level columns of the UNICEF Children's Climate Risk Report 2026 (the Single Hazard Exposure, Multihazard Exposure and Vulnerability sheets of ccrr_2026.xlsx, joined on iso3) attached to Natural Earth Admin 0 map-unit polygons (1:10m, v5.1.1, dissolved per ISO3). 248 of the 261 source rows have a polygon; the 13 without one are disputed or unsettled territories carried under x-prefixed pseudo-codes (12 of them have no data at all) and remain available in the tabular collection. Exposure counts are children under 18 (WorldPop 2024 constrained 100 m grid) living where a hazard exceeds the threshold set in the technical documentation; scores are 0-10 min-max normalised. Modelled estimates, not observations. Source: Children's Climate Risk on HDX, retrieved 2026-09-23.

links.title: CCRR 2026 - national indicators joined to country polygons

table:columns.name: iso3
table:columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code, unique; 248 real codes plus 13 UNICEF pseudo-codes starting with x for disputed or unsettled areas (xAB Abyei, xUK Akrotiri, xAC Aksai Chin, xAP Arunachal Pradesh, xxx China/India, xJK Jammu and Kashmir, xRI Kuril Islands, xPI Paracel Islands, xSR Scarborough Reef, xSK Senkaku Islands, xJL Sovereignty unsettled, xSI Spratly Islands, xFR Tromelin Island). The join key to the other two Collections (ISO3 in the overlapping-hazards table).

table:columns.name: ucode
table:columns.description: UNICEF unit code, <iso3>_V1 (e.g. JAM_V1; xUK1_V1, PYF1_V1).

table:columns.name: Country/Territory
table:columns.description: Publisher's name of the country or territory, e.g. Jamaica, Viet Nam, Clipperton Island.

table:columns.name: Children (Under 18) Population
table:columns.description: Children under 18, WorldPop 2024 constrained 100 m estimate summarised to the country ("Total number of children per 100mx100m pixel summarized to country level", Metadata sheet). 0 to 426,365,931 (India); NULL for 14 rows; sum 2,393,137,783.

table:columns.name: UNICEF Regional Office
table:columns.description: UNICEF regional office: East Asia and Pacific (27 rows), Europe and Central Asia (21), East and Southern Africa (21), Latin America and Carribean (36, publisher spelling), Middle East and North Africa (20), South Asia (8), West and Central Africa (24); NULL for 104 rows (high-income countries and territories with no UNICEF programme).

table:columns.name: OECD Fragility
table:columns.description: OECD States of Fragility classification: fragile (61 rows) or NULL.

table:columns.name: World Bank Income Group
table:columns.description: World Bank income group: High Income 86, Upper Middle Income 53, Lower Middle Income 50, Low Income 25, NULL 47.

table:columns.name: UN Country Groupings - LLDCs
table:columns.description: UN landlocked developing country: LLDC (32 rows) or NULL.

table:columns.name: UN Country Groupings - SIDS
table:columns.description: UN small island developing state: SIDS (39 rows) or NULL.

table:columns.name: Hazard Exposure Score
table:columns.description: Overall multi-hazard exposure score, 0-10, the geometric mean over the hazard scores; "multi-hazard score is calculated only when all hazards are available", so non-NULL for 198 of 261 rows. Ranking by it drops 63 territories.

table:columns.name: Number of Children Exposed to Riverine Floods
table:columns.description: Children under 18 (WorldPop 2024) living in pixels exposed to riverine floods (JRC Global Flood Hazard, 100-year return period, 90 m; threshold depth > 1 cm); integer count, NULL where the source says Not applicable, Insufficient data or blank.

table:columns.name: Percentage of Children Exposed to Riverine Floods
table:columns.description: Share (0-100) of the row's children under 18 exposed to riverine floods (JRC Global Flood Hazard, 100-year return period, 90 m; threshold depth > 1 cm).

table:columns.name: Riverine Flood Score (0-10)
table:columns.description: Publisher's combined 0-10 exposure score for riverine floods, bringing the absolute and relative scores onto one comparable scale (highest exposure = 10). Do not recompute it: a plain geometric mean of the two components does not reproduce it (Jamaica tropical storm: sqrt(6.36 x 10) = 7.97, published 8.32).

table:columns.name: Absolute Riverine Flood Score (0-10)
table:columns.description: Min-max normalised 0-10 score of the absolute number of children exposed to riverine floods. Normalisation (technical documentation): 10 - (baseline maximum - raw value) / (baseline maximum - baseline minimum) x 10, with the baseline taken after iteratively removing outliers.

table:columns.name: Relative Riverine Flood Score (0-10)
table:columns.description: Min-max normalised 0-10 score of the percentage of children exposed to riverine floods. Normalisation (technical documentation): 10 - (baseline maximum - raw value) / (baseline maximum - baseline minimum) x 10, with the baseline taken after iteratively removing outliers.

table:columns.name: Child Vulnerability Score
table:columns.description: Overall child vulnerability, 0-10 (10 = most vulnerable), the arithmetic mean of the seven component scores (health, nutrition, WASH, education, child protection, child poverty, child mortality); non-NULL for 186 rows. Raw indicators are from the UNICEF data warehouse as of April 2026.

table:columns.name: Health Score (0-10)
table:columns.description: Component score, 0-10, from DTP1 and DTP3 immunisation coverage, skilled birth attendance and access to electricity; positive indicators reversed so 10 is worst.

table:columns.name: Percentage of children with DTP 1 immunization coverage
table:columns.description: Raw vulnerability indicator: share of children with one dose of DTP vaccine, percent.

table:columns.name: DTP1 Score (0-10)
table:columns.description: Normalised 0-10 score of the DTP1 coverage indicator, reversed so 10 is worst.

table:columns.name: Percentage of children with DTP 3 immunization coverage
table:columns.description: Raw vulnerability indicator: share of children with three doses of DTP vaccine, percent.

table:columns.name: DTP3 Score (0-10)
table:columns.description: Normalised 0-10 score of the DTP3 coverage indicator, reversed so 10 is worst.

table:columns.name: Percentage of mothers with skilled attendant
table:columns.description: Raw vulnerability indicator: births attended by skilled health personnel, percent.

table:columns.name: Skilled Attendance Score (0-10)
table:columns.description: Normalised 0-10 score of the skilled attendance indicator, reversed so 10 is worst.

table:columns.name: Percentage of population with access to electricity
table:columns.description: Raw vulnerability indicator: population with access to electricity, percent.

table:columns.name: Electricity Score (0-10)
table:columns.description: Normalised 0-10 score of the electricity access indicator, reversed so 10 is worst.

table:columns.name: Nutrition Score (0-10)
table:columns.description: Component score, 0-10, from stunting and severe child food poverty.

table:columns.name: Children under five with a stunting z-score less than -2 SD
table:columns.description: Raw vulnerability indicator: children under five with height-for-age below -2 SD, percent.

table:columns.name: Stunting Score (0-10)
table:columns.description: Normalised 0-10 score of the stunting indicator.

table:columns.name: Percentage of children living in severe child food poverty
table:columns.description: Raw vulnerability indicator: children in severe child food poverty, percent.

table:columns.name: Food Poverty Score (0-10)
table:columns.description: Normalised 0-10 score of the severe child food poverty indicator.

table:columns.name: WASH Score (0-10)
table:columns.description: Component score, 0-10, from at-least-basic water, sanitation and hygiene access.

table:columns.name: Proportion of population with access to at least basic water
table:columns.description: Raw vulnerability indicator: population using at least basic drinking-water services, percent.

table:columns.name: At-least basic water Score (0-10)
table:columns.description: Normalised 0-10 score of the basic water indicator, reversed so 10 is worst.

table:columns.name: Proportion of population with access to at least basic sanitation
table:columns.description: Raw vulnerability indicator: population using at least basic sanitation services, percent.

table:columns.name: At-least basic sanitation Score (0-10)
table:columns.description: Normalised 0-10 score of the basic sanitation indicator, reversed so 10 is worst.

table:columns.name: Proportion of population with access to basic hygiene
table:columns.description: Raw vulnerability indicator: population with a handwashing facility with soap and water at home, percent.

table:columns.name: Basic hygiene Score (0-10)
table:columns.description: Normalised 0-10 score of the basic hygiene indicator, reversed so 10 is worst.

table:columns.name: Education Score (0-10)
table:columns.description: Component score, 0-10, from lower-secondary out-of-school and completion rates and learning poverty.

table:columns.name: Percentage of children out of lower secondary education
table:columns.description: Raw vulnerability indicator: lower-secondary-age children out of school, percent.

table:columns.name: Lower Secondary Out of School Score (0-10)
table:columns.description: Normalised 0-10 score of the lower-secondary out-of-school indicator.

table:columns.name: Percentage of children completing lower secondary education
table:columns.description: Raw vulnerability indicator: lower-secondary completion rate, percent.

table:columns.name: Lower Secondary Completion Rate Score (0-10)
table:columns.description: Normalised 0-10 score of the lower-secondary completion indicator, reversed so 10 is worst.

table:columns.name: Percentage of childre with learning poverty
table:columns.description: Raw vulnerability indicator: children in learning poverty (unable to read a simple text by age 10), percent. Publisher header kept verbatim, including the typo "childre".

table:columns.name: Learning Poverty Score (0-10)
table:columns.description: Normalised 0-10 score of the learning poverty indicator.

table:columns.name: Child Protection Score (0-10)
table:columns.description: Component score, 0-10, from child labour and child marriage.

table:columns.name: Percentage of children 5–17 years old involved in child labour
table:columns.description: Raw vulnerability indicator: children aged 5-17 in child labour, percent.

table:columns.name: Child Labor Score (0-10)
table:columns.description: Normalised 0-10 score of the child labour indicator.

table:columns.name: Percentage of women aged 20-24 years who were first married or in union before age 18
table:columns.description: Raw vulnerability indicator: women 20-24 first married or in union before 18, percent.

table:columns.name: Child Marriage Score Score (0-10)
table:columns.description: Normalised 0-10 score of the child marriage indicator. Publisher header kept verbatim, including the doubled "Score".

table:columns.name: Child Poverty Score (0-10)
table:columns.description: Component score, 0-10, from multidimensional child poverty and social protection coverage.

table:columns.name: Percentage children suffering at least one deprivation. Homogeneous severe standards
table:columns.description: Raw vulnerability indicator: children suffering at least one severe deprivation (multidimensional poverty, homogeneous severe standards), percent.

table:columns.name: Multidimensional Poverty Score (0-10)
table:columns.description: Normalised 0-10 score of the multidimensional child poverty indicator.

table:columns.name: Percentage of under 15 children covered by social protection
table:columns.description: Raw vulnerability indicator: children under 15 covered by social protection benefits, percent.

table:columns.name: Social Protection Score (0-10)
table:columns.description: Normalised 0-10 score of the social protection coverage indicator, reversed so 10 is worst.

table:columns.name: Child Moratlity Score (0-10)
table:columns.description: Component score, 0-10, from under-five mortality. Publisher header kept verbatim, including the typo "Moratlity".

table:columns.name: Under 5 Mortality (per 1000 live births)
table:columns.description: Raw vulnerability indicator: under-five mortality rate per 1,000 live births.

table:columns.name: Vulnerability Missing Value
table:columns.description: Share of the 17 vulnerability indicators missing for the row, percent (5.88 = 1 of 17); rows with too many missing indicators have no overall vulnerability score.

table:columns.name: n_cells_not_applicable
table:columns.description: Derived by CARTO: number of indicator cells that read "Not applicable" in the source row (12 rows, max 152: the x-coded areas and Holy See). The token became NULL in the numeric columns; this counter tells it apart from the other two.

table:columns.name: n_cells_insufficient_data
table:columns.description: Derived by CARTO: cells that read "Insufficient data" (17 rows; Nicaragua and State of Palestine 152 each, Nauru 48, Maldives 43, Tuvalu 43, Liechtenstein 39, Marshall Islands 38, Monaco 33, Cabo Verde, Mauritius, Samoa and Seychelles 32 each).

table:columns.name: n_cells_blank
table:columns.description: Derived by CARTO: cells that were empty strings (18 rows, mostly small territories such as Anguilla, Bermuda, Gibraltar, Greenland, Guam, Tokelau, Western Sahara).

table:columns.name: ne_name
table:columns.description: Derived: Natural Earth NAME_LONG of the largest map unit dissolved into the row.

table:columns.name: ne_type
table:columns.description: Derived: Natural Earth TYPE of that unit (Sovereign country, Country, Dependency, ...).

table:columns.name: ne_units
table:columns.description: Derived: number of Natural Earth map units dissolved into the polygon (1-9; GBR 4, PRT 3, UMI 9).

table:columns.name: ne_unit_names
table:columns.description: Derived: semicolon-joined Natural Earth NAME values of the dissolved units.

table:columns.name: ne_key_source
table:columns.description: Derived: which Natural Earth code matched the UNICEF iso3 (ISO_A3 234 rows, ADM0_A3 12, ISO_A3_EH 1, SU_A3=CLP (Clipperton) 1).

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Natural Earth Admin 0 map-unit polygons 1:10m v5.1.1 dissolved per iso3 (98 Polygon, 150 MultiPolygon), WGS 84 longitude/latitude (EPSG:4326); extent -180, -59.47, 180, 83.63; all valid.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: STRUCT(xmin DOUBLE, ymin DOUBLE, xmax DOUBLE, ymax DOUBLE)
table:columns.description: GeoParquet bbox covering column (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added by the conversion.
